evidence_excerpts: The cost-model evaluation uses 25,000 programs measured during ResNet-50 tuning on Intel CPU, with 20,000 for training and 5,000 for testing.
The model reports 0.079 RMSE, 0.958 R2 correlation, 0.851 pairwise comparison accuracy, and 0.624 recall@30 on the test set.
text: Ansor's learned cost model predicts tensor-program throughput accurately enough to guide search on the evaluated ResNet-50 dataset.
